title: Base change for extension by zero on bounded-below derived categories
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and, for a scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $D^+(T)$ be the bounded-below derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $\mathcal A$-valued sheaves on the small étale site $T_{\mathrm{\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $j\colon X\to Z$ and $j'\colon X'\to Z'$ be open immersions and $g\colon Z'\to Z$, $g'\colon X'\to X$ morphisms forming a cartesian square $X'=X\times_ZZ'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with $jg'=gj'$. Let $j_!$, $j'_!$ be extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and $g^*$, $g'^*$ the inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], all exact and extended to $D^+$. Then the canonical exchange morphism, the natural transformation $j'_!\,g'^*\Rightarrow g^*\,j_!$ of functors $D^+(X)\to D^+(Z')$ obtained as the mate of the comparison $j'^*g^*\cong g'^*j^*$ under the adjunctions $j_!\dashv j^*$, $j'_!\dashv j'^*$, is an isomorphism.
